{
  "implementation": "def solve(case):
    tokens = case['tokens']
    calls = case['calls']
    # sort calls by end time (ascending), and by start if tie
    calls_sorted = sorted(calls, key=lambda c: (c['end'], c['start']))
    n = len(calls_sorted)
    # compute p(j): rightmost call with end <= start of call j
    ends = [c['end'] for c in calls_sorted]
    p = [-1] * n
    for j in range(n):
        start_j = calls_sorted[j]['start']
        # binary search for last end <= start_j
        lo, hi = 0, j-1
        best = -1
        while lo <= hi:
            mid = (lo+hi)//2
            if ends[mid] <= start_j:
                best = mid
                lo = mid+1
            else:
                hi = mid-1
        p[j] = best
    # DP
    dp = [0] * n
    chosen = [False] * n
    for j in range(n):
        score = calls_sorted[j]['score']
        # take
        take = score + (dp[p[j]] if p[j] >= 0 else 0)
        # skip
        skip = dp[j-1] if j>0 else 0
        if take > skip:
            dp[j] = take
            chosen[j] = True
        else:
            dp[j] = skip
            chosen[j] = False
    # backtrack
    selected = []
    j = n-1
    while j >= 0:
        if chosen[j]:
            selected.append(calls_sorted[j])
            j = p[j]
        else:
            j -= 1
    selected.reverse()  # increasing start order
    # build tokens
    result_tokens = []
    pos = 0
    for call in selected:
        start, end = call['start'], call['end']
        # copy tokens from pos to start
        result_tokens.extend(tokens[pos:start])
        # add replacement tokens
        result_tokens.extend(call['replacement_tokens'])
        pos = end
    # copy remaining
    result_tokens.extend(tokens[pos:])
    selected_call_ids = [c['call_id'] for c in selected]
    return {'selected_call_ids': selected_call_ids, 'tokens': result_tokens}
"
}
